evidence_slice: The Department for Energy Security and Net Zero records the Secretary of State decision on the Mallard Pass Solar Farm development consent application, project reference EN010127, with a maximum output of up to 350 MW and decision date 12 July 2024. The Mallard Pass Solar Farm Order 2024 (UKSI 2024/796) grants development consent for the authorised development within the Order limits and came into force on 3 August 2024.
